obernants.approximation_semantics: Partial source-derived relation; finite evidence is not a proof.
obernants.assumptions: Successful allocation, trusted Rust standard library and compiler.
obernants.domain: Finite fixture/assertion observations; trusted compiler and test runner; passing is not unrestricted equivalence.
obernants.observation_scope: One terminating call or the named finite test suite.
obernants.operator: Accepted fixture/output pairs exclude mismatched oracle objectives, invalid witnesses and wrong tested errors. Outside-fixture behavior remains unconstrained.

obernants.operator: A pass reconstructs all implementations agreeing on the finite observations, including faulty unseen extensions. A failed assertion reconstructs unequal compared values at that fixture; it does not uniquely identify a source bug.
